descricao: The one-eyed giant of the Amazon, with a mouth in its belly. / O gigante de um olho só, com boca na barriga.
He steals from your inventory and can only be caught with a sieve. / Rouba seus itens e so a peneira pega.
Guardian of the forest, with flaming hair and backward feet. / Guardiao da mata, de pes virados.
The serpent of fire that puts out every blaze. / A cobra de fogo que protege os campos.
Pull off her iron bridle to break the curse. / Arranque o freio para quebrar o encanto.
She sings in the rivers. Don't look at her. / Nao olhe para ela.
The pink river dolphin that saves drowning swimmers. / O boto cor-de-rosa.

titulo: The young man in the white hat
descricao: At night the Boto walks out of the river. / A noite, o moco de chapeu branco.
She comes for whoever doesn't sleep. / Dorme, nene, que a Cuca vem pegar.
On full-moon nights. / Nas noites de lua cheia.
Her eyes glow in the dark. / Os olhos brilham no escuro.
A light of fire across the fields. / Uma luz de fogo no campo.
